title: One Day of YouTube Uploads Would Take 82 Years to Watch
lines: What happens on the internet in one single second?
In that second, | Google gets over {100,000~a hundred thousand} searches.
YouTube gets about {8 hours~eight hours} of new video. | Every second.
And between continents, | it goes under the sea.
About {1.4 million~one point four million} kilometers of cable, | enough to wrap the Earth {35 times~thirty-five times}.
In the deep sea, | many are as thick as a garden hose,
yet they carry over {99%~ninety-nine percent} of the traffic between continents.
Back on that one phone, | one day of YouTube uploads | would take about {82 years~eighty-two years} to watch. | Longer than a lifetime.
What damages undersea internet cables the most? | Shark bites, | or fishing gear and ship anchors? | Tell me in the comments.

preroll.line: More than {99%~ninety-nine percent} of the internet between continents runs under the sea.
